title: Tourists Brave a Muddy Jungle Trek to See a Famed World War II Wreck
summary_full: Seven Chinese tourists, a dozen villagers and a couple of journalists forded streams and bushwhacked to the downed plane of Isoroku Yamamoto, the Japanese admiral. Machetes proved handy.
